title: Admin dashboard
subtitle: Manage skills, users, worker imports, education uploads, news updates, and locale translations.
noPendingSkills: There are no pending skill proposals.

education.heading: Education guides
education.hint: Upload PDF or video files, choose short video / lecture / PDF, and publish localized titles for the Education page.
education.mediaTypeRequired: Choose short video, lecture, or PDF before saving.
education.fileLimits: PDF up to 100 MB. Video up to 2 GB.
education.uploadRequired: Choose a PDF or video file before saving.
education.uploadedReady: File uploaded. Click Save guide to publish it.
education.timedOut: This step timed out. Check your connection and try again.
education.networkError: Network error. The file was not uploaded.

news.heading: News updates
news.hint: Add short excerpts for the homepage scrolling news banner. Published items appear in order, separated by “ / ”.
news.bodyRequired: Enter an English excerpt before saving.

translations.heading: Locale translations
translations.hint: Edits write directly to messages/{locale}/{namespace}.json on the server. The messages directory must be writable.

workersImport.heading: Import workers
workersImport.hint: CSV rows create public worker profiles without a login unless user_email matches an existing account. Profiles appear on the map when they have coordinates (from postcode if lat/lng are blank).
workersImport.required: headline is required. contact_email, contact_phone, and linkedin_url are stored on the profile for contact reveal. user_email is optional. skills and desired_job_types are pipe-separated. Defaults: visibility=public, availability=immediate, actively_looking=true.
